notes: Llama-3.1-8B in float16 rather than bfloat16. Identical memory (both are two bytes) but 10 explicit mantissa bits against bfloat16's 7, so ~8x finer. The sweep's speed is a difference of two residuals of norm ~48 that differ by ~0.2, and in bfloat16 the rounding floor on that difference is 0.455 -- 69% of the measured step at n_u=141. float16 should cut it to ~0.06. The risk is range, not precision: float16 overflows at 65504 and Llama has large residual-stream outliers, so this config is only usable if the identity check and clean accuracy match the bfloat16 run. Verify before trusting it.
